parent_selection.selection_rule: The locked parent failed its full-actor gate, so both actors use the predeclared root-20 specifications.

source.compiler: gcc on one pinned ubuntu-24.04 build runner

only_candidate_changes: playout_sample 2 to 4: independently stratified suit mapping per player, fixed for the complete sampled trajectory
policy_prefix_mode 2 to 3: the fresh confirmation panel uses the same role-coherent continuation family
actors.partial_support_limit: The deterministic schedule covers all 20x20 ordered role mappings exactly in each complete 400-world block. The production 512-world panel adds 112 balanced repeats. Support-truncated late panels preserve distinct pairs and near-balanced marginals but are only a slice of the joint product; the strength test evaluates that exact implemented actor.

execution.inspection_rule: Do not inspect any efficacy output until all 20 shards complete, every raw sidecar hash passes, and the hardened reciprocal merge succeeds.

excluded_operational_smoke.purpose: Parser, complete-footer, and cap sanity only after freezing the actors; score and margin were discarded without inspection.

requirements: combined candidate match score minus 1.645 pair-clustered standard errors exceeds 0.5
candidate match-score point estimate exceeds 0.5 in each reciprocal orientation
zero cap-terminated rounds, incomplete shards, gaps, overlaps, malformed rows, provenance mismatches, or operational errors

required_provenance: exact actor specifications, seed, range, rounds, and thread count
